records.name: First World Feature Geometry
records.summary: Authorial geometry tying settlements, regional footprints, climate zones, biome zones, rivers, mountain belts, and travel corridors to the 2048x1152 reference map grid.

riverFeatures.name: Thalos Run
riverFeatures.notes: Primary river draining the Verdant Thalos farmlands into Aurelis Bay.

riverFeatures.name: Highcrown Headwater
riverFeatures.notes: Northern headwater river linking Silvergrove's forest margin to the Sapphire basin.

riverFeatures.name: Eastledger River
riverFeatures.notes: Eastern river branch feeding Ledgerford and Bridgewatch Ferry.

riverFeatures.name: Greenreach Fallriver
riverFeatures.notes: A forest river descending from the Green Reach toward Seabanner's harbor coast.

riverFeatures.name: Heartwater
riverFeatures.notes: Main basin river feeding Riverthrone and the surrounding grain districts.

riverFeatures.name: Southlock Branch
riverFeatures.notes: Southern distributary used by ferries and later canalized lock works.

riverFeatures.name: Silverrun
riverFeatures.notes: Valley river linking Talmyra's northern settlements to its southern spice ports.

riverFeatures.name: Mistfen Channel
riverFeatures.notes: Tidal river and mangrove channel cutting into the Watcher Coast.

mountainFeatures.name: Auric Highlands
mountainFeatures.notes: Highland chain west of Verdant Thalos holding Kaelvar's major dwarf mines.

mountainFeatures.name: Crownwall
mountainFeatures.notes: Cold northern mountain wall anchoring ancient headwaters and elven forest edges.

mountainFeatures.name: Windward Spine
mountainFeatures.notes: Serathyl's main mountain spine, crossed only by a handful of controlled passes.

mountainFeatures.name: Stormcap Rim
mountainFeatures.notes: Broken coastal heights along the southern rim of Draemor.

mountainFeatures.name: Talmyran Volcanics
mountainFeatures.notes: Ancient volcanic and cliff systems rising along Talmyra's eastern frontier.

passFeatures.name: Sunscar Gate
passFeatures.notes: Primary crown-road pass from Verdant Thalos into the Auric uplands.

passFeatures.name: Whitebark Gap
passFeatures.notes: Managed pass linking the cold headwater forests to the interior caravan corridor.

passFeatures.name: Northwind Stair
passFeatures.notes: Main cut pass descending from Passglass Hold toward the southern coasts.

passFeatures.name: Obsidian Stair
passFeatures.notes: Cliff pass anchoring Watcher Coast access from the inland valleys.

crossingFeatures.name: Kingsbridge
crossingFeatures.notes: Permanent bridgehead controlling a major Sapphire Rivers crossing.

crossingFeatures.name: Bridgewatch Ferry
crossingFeatures.notes: Managed ferry crossing on the eastern trade branch.

crossingFeatures.name: Redreed Ford
crossingFeatures.notes: A seasonal but heavily used ford on the interior plateau margin.

crossingFeatures.name: Southlock
crossingFeatures.notes: Canalized lock and ferry control point on Draemor's southern distributary.

crossingFeatures.name: Foammarket Ferry
crossingFeatures.notes: Inter-island ferry control point used by cargo and passengers inside the Myridian Chain.

crossingFeatures.name: Shattergap Strait
crossingFeatures.notes: Short but weather-sensitive strait between Kaelvar and the Shattercap approaches.

climateZones.name: Kaelvar Plateau Climate
climateZones.notes: Dry upland air and rain-shadow conditions shape the Kaelvar interior plateau.

climateZones.name: Verdant Thalos Climate
climateZones.notes: The southern Kaelvar coast enjoys mild winters and stable agricultural seasons.

climateZones.name: Shattercap Marine Climate
climateZones.notes: The northern Kaelvar islands are governed by cold maritime air and strong sea weather.

climateZones.name: Crownlands Headwater Climate
climateZones.notes: Northern forests and headwater snowpack dominate the upper Valtherion climate.

climateZones.name: Embersteppe Interior Climate
climateZones.notes: The interior plateau trends dry, windy, and exposed compared with the river basin margins.

climateZones.name: Sapphire Rivers Basin Climate
climateZones.notes: Large rivers and floodplains moderate temperatures and support the densest eastern agriculture.

climateZones.name: Jade Expanse Climate
climateZones.notes: The southern grass belts have longer warm seasons and dependable growing windows.

climateZones.name: Windward Spine Climate
climateZones.notes: Cold upland weather, cliffs, and exposed passes define the northern Serathyl spine.

climateZones.name: Green Reach Climate
climateZones.notes: Wet forest air and persistent rain keep Serathyl's interior lush and difficult to traverse.

climateZones.name: Sailor's Verge Climate
climateZones.notes: Serathyl's southern coast mixes mild winters with reliable sea humidity and long growing seasons.

climateZones.name: Draemor Basin Climate
climateZones.notes: The central basin and its lowland ring share the most stable large-scale agricultural climate on the map.

climateZones.name: Stormcap Coast Climate
climateZones.notes: The southern coast remains temperate but is shaped by surf, squalls, and salt exposure.

climateZones.name: Silver Valleys Climate
climateZones.notes: Talmyra's northern valleys are the warmest and most habitable interior zone on the frontier continent.

climateZones.name: Thorn Peninsula Climate
climateZones.notes: The southern peninsula is drier, hotter, and more dependent on coastal trade than the inland valleys.

climateZones.name: Watcher Coast Climate
climateZones.notes: Cliff-side moisture and coastal inlets create a wetter fringe along Talmyra's eastern edge.

climateZones.name: Myridian Marine Climate
climateZones.notes: The northern archipelago is driven by maritime trade winds and salt-rich air.

climateZones.name: Lantern Isles Climate
climateZones.notes: The central isles sit under variable ocean weather but avoid the coldest northern conditions.

climateZones.name: Serpent's Wake Climate
climateZones.notes: Storm belts and warm waters define the southern pirate arc.

climateZones.name: Dawnreach Polar Climate
climateZones.notes: The far-eastern islands sit inside a harsh polar-maritime weather regime.

biomeZones.name: Auric Marches Steppe
biomeZones.notes: The exposed Auric Marches are modeled as dry upland steppe.

biomeZones.name: Stonevein Underdark Belt
biomeZones.notes: The Stonevein hold and nearby tunnel works are treated as a subterranean underdark pocket.

biomeZones.name: Verdant Thalos Woodland
biomeZones.notes: The southern Kaelvar peninsula is modeled as Mediterranean woodland and vineyard country.

biomeZones.name: Shattercap Conifer Isles
biomeZones.notes: The northern islands mix rocky coasts with conifer cover and cold marine exposure.

biomeZones.name: Crownlands Taiga
biomeZones.notes: The Crownlands are modeled as a broad taiga and cold forest belt.

biomeZones.name: Embersteppe Steppe
biomeZones.notes: The dry interior of Valtherion is modeled as caravan steppe.

biomeZones.name: Sapphire Rivers Mixed Forest
biomeZones.notes: The eastern river basin is represented by mixed forest and floodplain margins.

biomeZones.name: Jade Expanse Prairie
biomeZones.notes: The southern Valtherion breadbasket is modeled as broad productive prairie.

biomeZones.name: Windward Spine Alpine
biomeZones.notes: The northern Serathyl uplands are modeled as alpine meadow and cliff country.

biomeZones.name: Passglass Holdfasts
biomeZones.notes: The major dwarven holdfasts beneath the Spine are treated as an underdark enclave.

biomeZones.name: Green Reach Rainforest
biomeZones.notes: The Green Reach is modeled as dense wet forest with heavy canopy cover.

biomeZones.name: Sailor's Verge Chaparral
biomeZones.notes: The southern maritime coast mixes scrub, salt wind, orchards, and dry slopes.

biomeZones.name: Heart Basin Prairie
biomeZones.notes: The heart of Draemor is modeled as river-watered prairie and grainland.

biomeZones.name: Emerald Mantle Forest
biomeZones.notes: The fertile lowlands around the basin are modeled as deciduous woodland and pasture edge.

biomeZones.name: Stormcap Coast Chaparral
biomeZones.notes: The Stormcap coast is represented by rugged scrub and salt-battered slopes.

biomeZones.name: Silver Valleys Seasonal Forest
biomeZones.notes: Talmyra's northern valleys are modeled as warm seasonal forest rather than full jungle.

biomeZones.name: Redroot Warrens
biomeZones.notes: The Redroot Warrens are a hidden subterranean enclave beneath the northern valleys.

biomeZones.name: Thorn Peninsula Dry Forest
biomeZones.notes: The Thorn Peninsula is modeled as tropical dry forest and spice country.

biomeZones.name: Watcher Coast Mangroves
biomeZones.notes: The mangrove inlets and tidal flats around Mistfen Landing form a distinct wet coastal zone.

biomeZones.name: Watcher Coast Cliffs
biomeZones.notes: The exposed eastern coast is modeled as cliffside scrub and broken stone.

biomeZones.name: Myridian Chaparral
biomeZones.notes: The Myridian islands are represented as dry island scrub with pockets of cultivation.

biomeZones.name: Lantern Isles Dry Coast
biomeZones.notes: The exposed Lantern Isles above water are modeled as scrubby coasts and rocky inlets.

biomeZones.name: Lantern Deepwater
biomeZones.notes: The hidden merfolk basin beneath the Lantern Isles is tracked as deep marine water.

biomeZones.name: Serpent's Wake Mangrove
biomeZones.notes: The southern pirate arc is modeled as warm mangrove-fringed island water.

biomeZones.name: Dawnreach Tundra
biomeZones.notes: The far-eastern islands are modeled as polar tundra and cold coastal shelves.

biomeZones.name: Nacredeep Basin
biomeZones.notes: The hidden merfolk trade basin east of Dawnreach is tracked as deep marine water.
